reading_rules: Delivery sites refer to a site where a programme is running, such as a home, campus, school programme, or shelter.
TPMAP target-poor people are age agnostic welfare-card counts, not a count of children in poverty.
Travel times are calculated from the district centre to the nearest relevant service provider.
The simplified routes do not represent the actual travelling routes from which the travel times are calculated, they are just an illustration.
Zero mapped sites is not proof that no provider exists.

insights.title: Mapped services concentrate around the city
insights.problem: Mueang Chiang Mai, San Sai and Doi Saket are home to 32 of 49 service providers with known addresses. 12 of 25 districts have zero mapped service providers or delivery sites.
insights.action: Rather than building new facilities, explore lower-cost outreach solutions: leverage existing organisations, delivery through schools or government offices in zero-site districts, and formal cross-district referral.

insights.title: The most impoverished areas lack family-support access
insights.problem: Mae Chaem has zero mapped family-support sites and 8,309 TPMAP target-poor people (19.85%), with a modelled 3 hours 6 minutes drive to the nearest public service provider. Chom Thong has zero sites, 3,755 target-poor (8.56%), and a 1 hour 26 minutes drive.
insights.action: These districts combine strong poverty signals, no mapped locations, and substantial travel. Partnership talks could explore a locally delivered family-preservation model for the district.

insights.title: Districts that have asked for help are still underserved
insights.problem: Omkoi has 17,373 registered Thai children 0–17, zero mapped family-support sites, 2,831 target-poor people, and the longest modelled family-support journey (3 hours 35 minutes). The school list shows 173 people identified as 'help-wanted', and 112 'never-studied' records, with no mapped after-school programme.
insights.action: Omkoi is not just remote, but home to a sizeable population that has already signalled a need for help. Integrated local partnerships could be explored to link family support with educational re-engagement.
